name.description: The name used to identify this action.

type.description: The kind of action implementation to use.

description.description: A human-readable explanation of what the action does.

warmup.description: The delay before the action takes effect. Is added to cooldown for player

cooldown.description: The delay after the action before it can be used again.

damage.description: The amount of damage dealt by the action.

animation.description: The name of the animation played for this action.
